Lucky Me Macaroni

I
have
very
vivid
memories
of
instant
macaroni
from
this
brand. I used to mix the baked mac variant with the mac &
cheese together to form a joint flavor. Apparently not a lot of
people did this — but I still stand by that it tastes amazing. I
sent over two Baked Mac and two Mac & Cheese.

Hopefully
you
can
have
a
similar
lunch
to
your
weekly
buldaks with Lara by each making your own Baked Mac &
Cheese (as I liked to call it) to eat together. You can also opt
to not mix them together, if that’s what you prefer. I hope
you enjoy this just as much as I did.
